title: Speaking — Demo Test 1
description: Part 1 interview, Part 2 long turn, Part 3 discussion.

questions: Do you live in a house or an apartment?
What do you like most about the area where you live?
Is it a quiet place or a busy one?
Would you like to move somewhere else in the future?
What do you do — do you work or are you a student?
What do you enjoy most about it?
What would you like to do in the future?
Do you prefer working alone or in a team?
What do you usually do in your free time?
How much free time do you have during the week?
Do you prefer spending free time at home or outdoors?
Did you have more free time when you were a child?

part2.topic: A skill you would like to learn
points: how long you think it would take
why you want to learn it
part2.closing: and explain why this skill is important to you.
and explain why you enjoy visiting this place.
and explain why their influence mattered to you.
and explain what you would do differently now.

questions: Why do some people find it easier to learn new skills than others?
Should schools teach practical skills as well as academic subjects?
Is it better to learn a skill from a teacher or from the internet?
Do you think people stop learning new skills as they get older?
What kinds of decisions are hardest for people to make?
Should young people ask their parents for advice about big decisions?
How has the internet changed the way people make decisions?
Are people today more or less confident about their decisions than in the past?
